sections.title: Daily-life logistics under pressure: meaning and form
body: Goal: Coordinate transport, childcare or errands when one part of a normal plan fails.
Core vocabulary: en försening, ett ärende, ordna. Key phrases: Tåget är försenat, så jag hinner inte i tid. · Kan du hämta barnen i dag? · Om du handlar ordnar jag middagen.

Use måste for necessity, behöver for need and hinner for having enough time. To negotiate, state the constraint and offer an alternative: Jag hinner inte före fem, men jag kan komma halv sex. Use om … så … to make a conditional plan explicit.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: What does the speaker ask the listener to do? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: Which deadline is earliest? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Coordinate a changed evening plan with another person. Explain two constraints, divide three tasks and confirm who does what. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Send a clear family or household message about a delay. Include the effect, a revised division of tasks and one conditional backup. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: The person who agreed to help is suddenly unavailable; create a second workable plan and notify those affected.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
